maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new safety products (gas detection, SCBA, fall protection, helmets); replacement sales exist but most revenue is product sales.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly industrial companies, utilities and oil and gas firms; fire service sales are partly government but minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through own product innovation and sales, with only occasional acquisitions such as Bacharach and Hazmasters.

mission_critical.reason: Life-safety gear like SCBA and gas detectors is certified and regulated; switching needs retraining, requalification and carries safety risk.

notes: Judgment on maintenance split is approximate; MSA has sizeable aftermarket and consumables revenue but new product sales likely dominate.
